protocol.source_only: Only z3 updates uniform; no later arrival writes its retained belief
protocol.continuous: All actual arrivals z3..z6 versus the same chronology omitting only z3
protocol.gaussian_comparator: Same responses and R; N(f_k,R), one source update, no refit
protocol.interaction_orientation: (speed0 movement - speed1 movement) - (speed0 stop - speed1 stop)
protocol.aggregation: Shared endpoint eligibility; sum numerator / sum truth squared norm; no mean of ratios
protocol.quiet_false_displacement: Stop prediction displacement from its own actual z6; actual drift also reported
protocol.future_truth_use: Scoring only; no z7..z10 passed to forecasts or belief writes
protocol.independent_record_unit: One actual simulator rollout per speed/program/reset seed
